C-SESSION-OWNED-SETTINGS.IntentSummary: Replace the family snapshot subsystem with session-owned settings in native session metadata. One new resolver module owns the narrow settings record (decode, birth from the effective config, lineage resolution, read-modify-write projection, migration); the shared native runtime drops the bind/guard/variant machinery and exposes the settings service; every plugin consumer switches from snapshots.configFor/accept to settings.configFor; explicit change arrives through /vv-settings in the TUI and `vvoc session set` in the CLI; the snapshot store, snapshot service, rebind markers, force flags, and /vv-rebind are deleted with their tests; README and the GRACE graph/verification projections are synchronized. Approved: the approved factory task is recorded as the owner authorization for both spec and plan.

MustContain.Text: a bound family keeps its captured profile while new work sees the changed policy

PlanningNotes.Note: Approval provenance: the approved factory task authorizes translating this bundle to approved and executing it; recorded per the GRACE approval rule. No separate user approval step remains.

Metadata semantics: session.update REPLACES the whole metadata map, so the only write path is read-modify-write of the `vvoc:settings` key; auxiliary imports create new sessions and never count as metadata writes.

Settings record format is fixed: {version:1, preset?, roles, profile, plugins} with resolved values; plugin toggles keep resolved booleans only, so object-valued plugin entries (schedules, modes) always resolve from the live configuration.

Projection semantics: the consumer-facing projected config deep-clones the live effective config and overrides roles, orchestration.profile, and the plugin toggle booleans governed by the family record; credentials never come from metadata.

Role application after the change: the family root model is never switched or validated; children apply roles at creation (agent editor transforms stay creation-level; host-created children get a one-shot creation reconciliation switch from family settings; auxiliary children carry the model in the import payload as today). The model-roles toggle gates all role application.

Race discipline: inside the runtime, per-family RMW serializes through the existing coordination family lock; the birth path caches the born fact per session id in-process; CLI/TUI perform a single RMW and the window is documented.

Migration: runs at first runtime acquisition per project scope; converts each stored binding into the root's metadata for live roots, skips dead roots, deletes the scope's bindings/snapshots/rebind directories only after a fully successful pass, and keeps them for retry on any failure.

Host pin: the e2e harness pin follows docs/host-updates.md; if the 2.2.6 binary cannot be verified live in this environment the change records an explicit residual note instead of a fabricated hash, and the harness keeps the newest verified pin.
PlanningNotes.KnownFlake: Known-flakes item 3: bun run check on an unpatched checkout failed at the grace markup gate. All markup edits are in scope here, so the gate must pass on the finished tree; judged only after the gate finishes.
PlanningNotes.Note: No final-review obligation is declared by the source; the factory verify stage reviews the result. GRACE lifecycle commands stay external and never nest inside plan commands.

T-001.Title: Build the session-settings module: record format, decode, birth, lineage resolution, RMW projection, migration.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: src/runtime/session-settings.ts defines the versioned FamilySettings record, strict decode (invalid input yields undefined plus a bounded reason), settingsFromConfig from the effective runtime config, the projected consumer view (live config with family-governed fields overridden, credentials only from live), lineage-to-root resolution ported from resolveSessionFamily with cycle/depth guards, and the RMW helper that merges only the `vvoc:settings` key into the full metadata map.

The migration converter reads a bindings scope directory, projects each stored snapshot into the narrow record, RMW-writes it into live root sessions, skips dead roots, and removes the bindings/snapshots/rebind directories only after full success.

Colocated tests cover: decode acceptance/rejection, from-config values, projection merge semantics (foreign live fields survive, toggles override), RMW preserving a foreign metadata key, lineage cycle/depth refusal, and migration one-shot with second-run no-op plus dead-root skip and failure retention.
Module contract, map, and change summary anchors are accurate.

T-002.Title: Rewire the shared native runtime onto the settings service and delete the guard machinery.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The native snapshot context seam widens session.update to accept metadata and keeps the compile-time Plugin.Context proof.

The runtime exposes a settings service (familyOf, configFor with lazy birth for roots, resolve, explicit update, auxiliary) and drops: bindFor, guardResolvedModel, prompt/generate/model.request guard hooks, explicitSelections/pluginSwitches/firstWorkPending/creationModels/creationDefaults/suppressedTitles state, variant materialization and pending registrations, admitOwned, rebind, removeFamily wiring, and the snapshot-service registry.

A one-shot creation reconciliation switches host-created children to the family's role model when role overriding is enabled, once per child, without any later validation; the title auxiliary path resolves roles from family settings; the config watcher keeps refreshing the live config; session deletion keeps only in-process cache hygiene.
Migration runs once at first runtime acquisition per project scope, fail-soft.

src/runtime/types.ts drops the snapshot vocabulary that loses all consumers (SnapshotService, SnapshotStore, StagedCandidate, AdmissionOutcome, accepted-input helpers, guard error classes) and adds the settings types; snapshot-config.ts keeps effectiveRuntimeConfig/parseRoleSelections/agent bindings helpers and drops the behaviour projection/hash/provenance/watch code; model-registry.ts drops variant registration and qualification helpers that lose consumers.

Deleted files: src/runtime/snapshots.ts{,.test.ts}, src/runtime/snapshot-store.ts{,.test.ts}, src/lib/rebind-request.ts{,.test.ts}; grep for SnapshotAdmissionError|SnapshotUnboundError|SnapshotStoreError|firstWorkPending in src/ is empty.
context.test.ts and auxiliary.test.ts reflect the new surface; module anchors stay accurate.

T-003.Title: Move all plugin consumers onto the settings resolver.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: workflow, system-context-injection, analytics, guardian, hashline-edit, peak-hours, secrets-redaction, spec-guard, tool-history-compaction, web-tools, model-roles resolve family policy through runtime.settings.configFor (one call, no accept retry); the workflow WorkflowRuntime surface narrows to the settings service.
The rewritten workflow integration test proves AC-01: a session whose family record carries profile X keeps resolving X after the underlying config flips to Y, and a fresh session resolves Y.
context-inspection projects the settings view through the same allowlisted policy DTO with value-free errors; its tests cover the new source.

model-roles keeps setRoleOverride as the role-application toggle; the model-roles integration suite is rewritten for creation-level role application (editor transforms plus one-shot child reconciliation) with the guard/bind scenarios removed or converted to birth/resolve coverage.
Other plugin integration suites that inject fake snapshot runtimes are updated to the settings surface without behavior regression.

T-004.Title: Explicit change commands: /vv-settings TUI command and vvoc session set CLI; remove --force and rebind plumbing.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: src/tui/settings/plugin.ts registers /vv-settings beside /context using the existing slot/keymap pattern: preset | profile | role | plugin toggle actions plus a pull-current-defaults action, writing through the running runtime's settings update for the active session's family root, one bounded toast per outcome, disabled without an open session.

src/commands/session.ts implements `vvoc session set --session <id>` with --preset | --profile | --role id=model | --role unset:id | --plugin name=on|off | --pull-defaults; it discovers the running host through Service.discover/Service.headers, resolves lineage to the root, and performs one RMW; no live host is a clear error. Registered in src/cli.ts.
preset.ts, role.ts, plugin-toggle.ts lose --force/--session flags and all rebind-marker calls; preset/role tests and plugin-toggle tests are updated.

src/tui.tsx drops the rebind facade and registers the settings command; tui/rebind/* is deleted with its test; new command tests cover the isolation property (only the named family changes) and the RMW foreign-key property.

Verification.Command: bun test src/commands/session.test.ts src/commands/preset.test.ts src/commands/role.test.ts src/commands/plugin-toggle.test.ts
